s.t:
Are you a seasoned product manager looking to build experiences that millions of people rely on to discover new ways to make a living with Uber? Are you energized by creating user journeys where magical experiences, growth, and trust must work hand in hand? If so, this role might be for you.
As a Lead Product Manager your impact on the business side, onboarding, and making new drivers successful is the lifeblood that powers Uber's growth and creates a path to economic empowerment for millions of people every year.
In this role, you will envision and deliver a multi-gig experience that is intuitive, fast, globally scalable and tailored to different earner segments. You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how drivers and couriers discover new earning opportunities, maximize their earnings and manage their platform access across all of their gigs.
This role requires strong product sense, a good understanding of the driver persona and their motivations and great crossfunctional agility. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, operations, legal, and trust & safety partners to build experiences that support and scale with the speed of our business.

The Earner growth team sits at the heart of the earner lifecycle and plays a foundational role in Uber's global growth. We are responsible for maximizing the number of quality, high performing earners on the platform.

We achieve this through optimizing the onboarding experience, enabling earners to progress during their early lifecycle and by helping to maximize their earning potential through multiple gigs to increase retention. In the event that earners churn, we also focus on bringing them back to the platform.

Own the product roadmap and lead vision, definition and execution for building Uber's earner multi gig experience.
Rethink the journey - deeply understand earners, their motivations and challenges and keep making the gig discovery and recommendation experience better.
Innovate - find new ways of simplifying the user experience with new technologies.
Distill vision and strategy for the team, get all members of cross-functional team #superpumped.
Own your numbers, drive your cross-functional team of engineers, data scientist, product ops and designers to set qualitative objectives and quantitative goals -- and overachieve them.
Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results to leadership.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience.
Experience delivering highly successful and creative consumer Internet products with your fingerprints all over them - you're proud of what you've accomplished.
Data-driven: you always get the data you need, and you can distill it into an insightful story. Most importantly, you leverage data to drive strategic decisions.
Technical skills. Ability to inform and evaluate engineering decisions.

Any experience working with gig economy earners
Launching products in different international markets
Experience in building and optimizing complex user acquisition funnels or recommendation engines
~~ ~~
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $216,000 per year - USD $240,000 per year.
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.
Ready to Ride?
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

About You You are an AI Technical Product Manager who is passionate about building AI-powered products that solve real business problems and deliver measurable value. You thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and artificial intelligence, translating strategic objectives into scalable product solutions.

You enjoy working with cross-functional teams, defining product vision, prioritizing initiatives, and driving AI adoption across the organization. You are analytical, customer-focused, and comfortable balancing business needs, technical feasibility, and user experience to maximize the impact of AI investments.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. 3+ years of experience managing enterprise software products and product roadmaps.

Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and managing product backlogs. Strong understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals. Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and Prompt Engineering.

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Enterprise Knowledge Bases. Experience defining KPIs, measuring product performance, and driving user adoption. Ability to translate business requirements into user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.

Experience leading Agile product delivery with cross-functional teams. Understanding of Data Governance, Analytics, Responsible AI, and AI governance principles. Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. Advanced English proficiency.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Define and maintain the AI product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives. Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, ROI, and organizational impact. Own and manage the AI product backlog throughout the product lifecycle.

Translate business requirements into user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria. Lead AI product discovery sessions with business stakeholders. Drive the evolution of AI knowledge bases, Semantic Search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Enterprise Intelligence capabilities.

Partner closely with Engineering, Data, Operations, and Executive Leadership to successfully deliver AI-powered products. Drive stakeholder engagement, product adoption, organizational alignment, and change management initiatives. Define, monitor, and optimize product KPIs, business outcomes, and value realization metrics.

Ensure Responsible AI, governance, compliance, and best practices are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle. Continuously improve AI products through customer feedback, experimentation, and iterative delivery.

Communicate AI capabilities, risks, limitations, and opportunities to both technical and business audiences. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. Experience building AI-powered products, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, or AI Agents. Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, KPIs, and managing product backlogs.

Strong understanding of Machine Learning concepts and AI governance. Advanced English proficiency. About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact.

As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are a product-driven organization building technology that unlocks the value in video and image data without compromising the people it captures. As part of Milestone Systems, we bring together anonymization and responsibly sourced, fully traceable video data with specialized AI models across our product portfolio.

We are seeking an ambitious Product Manager driven by customer satisfaction, product success, and opportunities for growth. You will work with customers, commercial and development teams, and senior management to align on a product vision, define a roadmap, and bring stakeholders together to continuously develop our product strategy.

If you understand the software-as-a-service business model and AI and computer-vision technologies, this role is for you. You must have a passion for great customer experiences paired with strong product skills. This is what will make you successful in this role.

You will define a product vision together with the Director of Product and the product team, set strategic priorities, and translate this vision into a product roadmap supported by meaningful KPIs.
You will approach customers and stakeholders with genuine curiosity and translate these insights into ideas and actions that delight them.
You will act as the strategic link between product vision and technical execution and be responsible for product ownership across the development teams.
You will identify opportunities for new products and product improvements by researching markets and interacting with customers, potential customers, and partners.
You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders such as tech development and support teams, sales, and senior management to shape and drive the product agenda.

s.h: IN ORDER FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU BRING
s.t:
You have 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager in a technical environment or a comparable position, ideally in B2B SaaS, artificial intelligence, or both.
You have strong skills in defining product, product vision, and product family strategy.
You are an effective product advocate who communicates clearly with stakeholders at every level and ensures that feedback from customers and internal teams directly influences product development.
You have a good understanding of software-as-a-service business models.
You are a self-starting leader, detail-oriented, process-oriented, and organized.
You are fluent in written and spoken English.

Friendly cooperation at eye level - We live and breathe flat hierarchies with a positive feedback culture.

Benefits to smooth your ride in life - Public transport ticket with a 50% subsidy and a huge discount on Urban Sports Club memberships.
Boost your learning – we’ll fund it - We offer a generous learning budget so you can improve your skills.
Loft-office in central Berlin - With free drinks and a large balcony with barbecue.

We are a diverse, ambitious team with a great passion for data privacy, generative AI and startups. Our office is in the heart of Berlin, one of the coolest, most vibrant cities worldwide. We enjoy teamwork and celebrating successes together. If you are looking for a new challenge with real impact from day one, check out our job openings and apply today!

Who We Are We started our company to help others launch and run their own businesses, at any stage. The way we help is by keeping it simple and supporting entrepreneurs one step at a time. Put simply: our mission is to enable anyone to start, run, and grow their business while avoiding the common pitfalls that derail hopeful entrepreneurs.

No more having to wade through forms, taxes, or ongoing state compliance. We are a remote company based in Austin, Texas. We have team members from Florida to Oregon and all points in-between. Take pride in your work knowing that it shapes how people all across the country reach their goal of starting, running, and growing their business.

If the idea of helping people and working with a genuinely caring, supportive team excites you, then you’ve come to the right place. The Role We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the logged-in customer experience at ZenBusiness — the first experience a new business owner sees after signing up and starting to run their company.

This role is about everything that happens after completing their formation: how we keep them coming back, deepening the value they get from our product suite, and turning first-time customers into long-term relationships. You'll own the product roadmap for our native apps (iOS and Android) and web dashboard.

Your mandate is to create a unified, delightful, self-serve experience that helps business owners get more out of every ZenBusiness product they own — from formations and compliance to marketing and fintech — and to drive more awareness and attachment of our highest-value offerings they don’t yet own.

This is a high-visibility individual contributor role that reports directly to the VP of Product, Growth. Responsibilities Build a unified product experience with Velo at the center Define and drive the product roadmap for the logged-in Web & native app experiences, focused on engagement depth, repeat usage, and in-app monetization.

Partner with our Velo team to bring our AI business guide to the center of our logged in experience, leveraging the unique capabilities of our agentic platform to do more for our business owners.

Collaborate closely with the product managers who own our individual products — formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech — to bring the best of each into a single, coherent customer experience. Identify and run experiments to lift core engagement, retention, and product-attachment metrics.

Work cross-functionally with design, engineering, and marketing to execute against that vision. Drive usage and attachment of our highest-value products Drive activation across our product suite by directly leading activation initiatives and equipping other PMs with the tools to drive activation themselves.

If a customer paid for it, your job is to get them to use it. Drive higher activation and usage of our key formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech products by surfacing the right capability at the right moment.

Increase awareness and attachment of our highest-value products through thoughtful CTAs, cross-sell sequencing, and upsell entry points — without compromising the customer experience. Use experimentation and customer data to find friction in the purchase funnel and optimize conversion at every step.

Act as the primary Product point of contact across product marketing, customer success, finance, and other teams that contribute to increasing customer attach rate and retention.

Operate as a builder Use AI across the product lifecycle — research, ideation, prototyping, experiment design — with tools like Claude, Lovable, v0, and Replit as your default mode of working, not a one-off. Prototype your high-potential ideas and put them in front of real customers or internal users for rapid feedback and iteration.

Contribute to our product features that create real customer value — with the judgment to know where AI deepens the experience vs. where it's a distraction. What We're Looking For 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a Staff or senior PM level.

Proven track record owning mobile app products (iOS and/or Android) — you understand the platform, the patterns, and how to drive engagement on native surfaces. Demonstrated ability to design unified experiences across multiple products and partner closely with other PMs to make the whole greater than the sum of its parts.

Experience designing self-serve customer experiences with thoughtful escalation paths to human support. Strong instincts around monetization — you know how to position products, write CTAs, structure purchase flows, and find the friction that kills conversion.

Experience working across web and native apps simultaneously; you think in customer journeys, not platforms. Strong collaborator with design and engineering; you can drive decisions without authority. Comfortable in ambiguity — this role requires you to set direction, not execute someone else's roadmap.

Bonus: experience with AI-powered product features, SMB or subscription products, or growth experimentation. Why This Role Matters ZenBusiness serves over 1 million small business owners, and our product suite spans formations, compliance, marketing, and fintech.

This role exists to ensure that entrepreneurs can use ZenBusiness as their operating system to confidently grow their business. The dashboard and native app are where the ZenBusiness experience comes to life. Remote Culture. A great company culture leads to happy employees, and happy employees lead to happy customers.

We provide our employees with good salaries, benefits, equity, and interesting challenges that have a positive impact. Let’s stay connected! We believe in staying connected, and we have a weekly “All Hands” meeting every week. We also have a social committee that hosts frequent events.

We’ve held a virtual talent show, costume competitions, monthly lunch and learn series, Hackathons and more! Benefits. The company offers various benefits to employees and their dependents, including medical, vision, dental, disability, and life insurance, as well as parental and military leave.

Other benefits include an employee assistance program, 401k + match, annual bonus, pet insurance, and RSUs. Paid parking* and 10 paid holidays are also provided. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in diversity, equity & inclusion .

At ZenBusiness , every voice counts no matter your race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, location, or background. We celebrate the diversity of our teams, knowing that our products, services, and customers thrive best when we lean into and celebrate our differences.

Please check out our careers' page to learn more about our culture, benefits, and open opportunities. *applicable to in-office employees Originally posted on Himalayas

Description This role requires two in-office days per week for candidates who live within 50 miles of Portsmouth, NH; Plano, TX; Seattle, WA; or Boston, MA.
USRM Electronic Content Solutions (ECS) is seeking a Product Owner to join our Forms Development team, responsible for delivering scalable, compliant, and cost-effective insurance form solutions for Auto, Property, and Umbrella products.

This role is integral to enabling Liberty Mutual's ability to bring policy forms to market quickly and accurately while supporting regulatory compliance, profitability programs, and platform convergence initiatives. You'll work within a mature, high-throughput forms factory model serving USRM's largest business priorities.
Join a team at the center of how Liberty Mutual brings insurance products to market. You'll own the delivery of policy form content that directly impacts profitability, regulatory compliance, and customer experience — while shaping a modernizing forms ecosystem undergoing significant convergence and operating model evolution. If you thrive on balancing speed, quality, and stakeholder complexity in a high-throughput environment, this is your role.

Experience in insurance forms, document management, or publishing/content management systems
Familiarity with regulatory/compliance filing processes and state-level insurance requirements beneficial
Background working with form template technologies (e.g., LibreOffice, open-source document generation tools, or similar)
Experience managing vendor/contractor delivery
Comfort working across multiple stakeholders (forms analysts, compliance, product, engineering) in a matrixed environment
Understanding of SLA-driven delivery models and cycle time optimization
Experience with agile delivery at scale

Contributes to the creation of product vision and alignment with strategic priorities with stakeholders. Communicates the product and portfolio vision to their squad/team and other squads/teams outside their portfolio/functional area.
With the squad/team, contributes towards achieving assigned product KPIs.
Manages form development product delivery across multiple lines of business (Auto, Property, Umbrella) with increasing complexity driven by regulatory requirements, multi-brand convergence, and cross-portfolio dependencies
Owns and maintains the product backlog and is accountable for its contents, prioritization, and acceptance criteria. Accountable for clear, actionable user stories.
Sets priorities and actively participates in squad/team quarterly planning. Sets expectations with stakeholders for delivery of new capabilities, features, and functionalities. Participates in PI Planning ceremonies and sets sprint/PI-level priorities in alignment with ECS OKRs, USRM business priorities, and forms analyst filing timelines
Participates in squad/team demos, retrospectives, and all other ceremonies.
Works daily with the Agile working group clarifying business requirements, removing roadblocks, constantly communicating, and supporting alignment around product strategy. Contributes to aligning development and business goals and priorities while working with stakeholders and squad/team to remove roadblocks to execution.
Monitors and maintains the product health, supporting long-term product viability and efficiency, and balancing long and short term and costs with desired outcomes.
Analyzes feasibility, cost of delay ramifications, economies, or other aspects of planned or potential changes to the product.
Understands regulatory, compliance, and other industry constraints on the product and prioritizes accordingly. Negotiates with immediate squads/teams to ensure priorities are aligned in a portfolio.
Collaboratively builds the squad/team product roadmap based on strategy and ongoing input from stakeholders. Communicates expected value and any changes in value to be delivered in each iteration (sprint, monthly, quarterly, etc.) based on the squad/team-determined capacity.
Partners with contract analysts, Product domain teams, and ECS engineering leadership to maintain a rolling 12-month roadmap that accounts for state filings, program launches, modernization milestones, and form rationalization targets
Contributes in customer-driven design and usability testing. Ensures a well-positioned product through market & industry analysis.
Drives cost efficiency through form rationalization, reuse standards, and scalable solutions
Partners with vendor form development teams to manage delivery throughput, quality, and adherence to defined SOPs and standards
Qualifications Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and IT project management as typically acquired through a Bachelors` degree in relevant field (business, computer science, humanities, etc.) and a minimum of 2 to 4 years direct experience with agile teams as well as 5 years in business, technology or consulting.
Able to depict complex ideas, issues and designs to varied audiences; educate SBU/department(s) on business vision and plan and the impact of change.
Able to make difficult and quick decisions daily.
Problem solver with ability to lead the team to push the solutions and progress.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

At Nebius, we’re building a next-generation AI compute platform for large-scale ML training and inference — from a few nodes to thousands of GPUs.

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager to own product direction for Soperator — our Slurm-on-Kubernetes control plane for GPU clusters.

In this role, you will shape how ML engineers and research teams run, scale, and optimize distributed workloads in production.

If you care about systems that combine performance, reliability, and developer experience at the frontier of AI infrastructure, this role is for you.

· Own the full user journey across Soperator clusters: Slurm workflows, dashboards, alerts/notifications, node lifecycle, and training/inference capacity management.

· Define product direction end-to-end: problem discovery → solution design → delivery → adoption .

· Lead deep customer discovery through interviews, usage analytics, and workload analysis to uncover high-impact opportunities.

· Drive execution across platform teams: compute, networking, storage, observability, IAM and etc.

· Translate frontier ML and infrastructure ideas into practical product capabilities for real-world GPU clusters.

· Define success metrics, prioritize roadmap decisions with data, and ensure measurable customer/business impact.

· Lead the open-source strategy and execution for Soperator: shape public roadmap themes, prioritize OSS-facing capabilities, and ensure strong adoption in the community.

· 3–5+ years in Product Management, ML infrastructure/MLOps, distributed systems, or cloud platform engineering.

· Strong technical depth in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or ML platforms.

· Hands-on familiarity with large-scale ML training and orchestration tools (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray ).

· Track record of shipping technically complex products with multiple engineering teams.

· Strong communication and stakeholder management across engineering, research, and customers.

· Experience with product analytics, data-informed prioritization, and experimentation.

· High ownership, high learning velocity, and comfort operating in fast-moving AI infrastructure environments.

s.h: It will be an added bonus if you have
s.t:
· Experience with GPU platforms and HPC primitives: InfiniBand/RDMA, topology-aware scheduling , high-throughput storage.

· Practical understanding of modern ML training stacks: PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP/ZeRO, NCCL .

· Familiarity with efficiency and reliability metrics: Goodput, MFU, failure modes, preemption handling, health checks .

· Exposure to large-scale LLM training/inference systems.

· Experience in observability, performance tuning, or SRE/reliability engineering.

· Customer-facing technical experience (solutioning, support, architecture advisory).

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware.

This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day.

· Competitive compensation

· Career growth and learning opportunities

· Flexibility and ownership

· Collaborative and innovative culture

· Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

· International environment and talented teams

Wir verwandeln bedeutende Momente in wunderschöne Erinnerungen.
celebrate ist eine Markengruppe mit der Mission in ganz Europa schöne Momente in bleibende Erinnerungen zu verwandeln: mit hochwertigen Papierwaren, Fotoprodukten und besonderen Geschenkartikeln.
Wir suchen einen Tech Product Manager (m/w/d) für unser Platform-Team, der Struktur, Klarheit und Dynamik in unsere Plattformstrategie bringt – in einer Phase tiefgreifender Transformation. Du verantwortest die Platform-Roadmap, koordinierst über Engineering-, Produkt- und Vendor-Teams hinweg und stellst sicher, dass die Plattform als echter Beschleuniger für unsere Marken funktioniert. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CTO und arbeitest in einem hybriden Setup mit hoher Eigenverantwortung.
Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt bei 70.100€ bis 94.800€ brutto pro Jahr (Senior).
Deine Rolle
Ownership der Platform-Roadmap inklusive Backlog-Priorisierung, Sequenzierung und Dependency-Mapping – mit dem Ziel, langfristige Plattformgesundheit und kurzfristige Lieferfähigkeit in Balance zu halten
Cross-Team-Koordination über Platform Engineering, Produktteams und externe Vendor (z. B. CommerceTools, PIMCore) hinweg, um Initiativen abzustimmen, die mehrere Domänen betreffen
Technische Spezifikation und Entscheidungsfindung durch Requirements-Dokumente, RFC-/ADR-Prozesse und Vendor-Evaluierungen – mit dem Anspruch, Dokumentation aktuell zu halten und Agentic-Style-Engineering zu ermöglichen
Vermittlung des Mehrwerts der Plattformarbeit für Stakeholder durch die Übersetzung von technischem Fortschritt, Entscheidungen und Trade-offs in klare, nachvollziehbare Business Outcomes

Wir schätzen Flexibilität: Flexible Remote-Arbeit, Teilzeitoptionen, moderne Hardware (Macbooks), kollaborative Büroflächen (Flex Desks)
Wir begrüßen New Work: Agile Arbeitsweise, Fair Pay, Kompetenz- und Führungsmodelle
Wir möchten, dass es dir gut geht: Nilo.health, Corporate Benefits, JobRad, Workations, Sabbaticals, 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub sowie dein persönliches Benefit nach Wahl: Wellpass, Hansefit oder das DB-Jobticket.
Wir wollen mit dir wachsen: Interne Weiterbildung, Coaching, regelmäßige Feedback- und Wachstumsprozesse, flexible externe Lernmöglichkeiten
Wir sind ein Team: Office-Frühstück und Lunch, (freiwillige) Events, Remote Team-Building, Office Dogs, und exklusive Family & Friends-Rabatte
Dein Profil
3–5 Jahre Erfahrung als Technical Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise in komplexen Multi-Brand- oder Multi-Plattform-Umgebungen
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im technischen Schreiben und in der Dokumentation, einschließlich Architekturübersichten, Integrationsguides, ADRs und API-Dokumentation
Fließendes Englisch erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse auf konversationellem Niveau sind ein Plus
Dein Mindset
Platform as product – Du verstehst die Plattform als eigenständiges Produkt mit klarer Value Proposition, internen Nutzern (Engineering-Teams) und hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
Documentation-as-Product – Du behandelst Dokumentation als erstklassiges Ergebnis, nicht als Nachgedanken, weil du überzeugt bist: Was nicht dokumentiert ist, ist nicht fertig.
Ruhe in der Komplexität – Du bleibst gelassen, wenn sich Prioritäten verschieben und Systeme ineinandergreifen, und bringst Struktur in Ambiguität, ohne Prozesse zu überdesignen.

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

The Opportunity
HelloFresh is the world's leading meal-kit company, serving millions of subscribers across 18 markets. Historically, we have grown through paid acquisition, but the way people discover food is changing twice over.

Search is being reshaped by AI, and a new generation of consumers is asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity to "plan dinner for my family this week" instead of opening an app or a search engine. Whoever shows up in those answers wins the category-default position. Whoever does not is invisible.
We own the meal-kit category in organic search and in LLMs. The broader food and recipe universe, where 150M+ monthly searches live, is still dominated by publishers with decades of content authority. Closing that gap is one of the largest, most durable growth opportunities in the business, and it is the mandate of the Organic Growth squad.
We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead Organic Growth and level it up from a traditional SEO function into a modern organic discovery engine spanning SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and an emerging Agentic Commerce mandate. This is the single-threaded leadership role for how HelloFresh and Factor get discovered, cited, and chosen across Google and AI surfaces.

You will own the end-to-end product strategy for organic discovery technical SEO, content infrastructure at scale, GEO and AI visibility, and the early Agentic Commerce surface that turns discovery into action inside LLMs.

You'll inherit a real foundation: a quality-first content strategy, recipe-collection automation, a GEO editorial framework, and a shipped Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App proof-of-concept. Your job is to take that to a responsible scale.

You will set the direction for a cross-functional squad Product, Engineering, Data/ML, SEO, Content/Editorial, and UX and act as the connective tissue across Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial. You will operate with high agency and a strong bias for ownership: this role is for a builder who takes accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.
What you'll own
SEO-the engine
End-to-end technical and content SEO across HelloFresh and Factor: crawlability, indexation, structured data, internal linking, SSR, sitemaps, and CMS/content-platform infrastructure.
Content scale with guardrails: recipe detail pages, automated recipe collection pages, editorial/blog, recipe internationalization, and UGC signals (ratings, reviews, authorship) — growing the footprint without falling into the content-debt trap.
Move the org from meal-kit catalog to food destination: identify high-volume recipe and food queries where we have no page, and build them.
GEO-the next surface
Own AI visibility and citation share across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, measured via Profound across a priority set of food and meal-kit prompts.
Drive our +25ppt GEO Visibility Score target (HF + Factor) by EOY 2026 through GEO-specific content formats built for AI citation, narrative-shaping editorial, and coordinated signals across owned, editorial, PR/affiliate, and social surfaces.
Operationalize "good SEO is good GEO" while owning the GEO-only tactics (comparison/listicle content, third-party narrative, non-Google LLM optimization) that pure SEO misses.
Agentic Commerce-the emerging bet
Extend organic discovery from "showing up" to "converting": connect GEO presence to our Agentic Commerce surface so discovery in an LLM turns into action.
Partner with New Ventures on the Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App and the hub-and-spoke platform (MCP / Apps SDK, then Claude and Gemini), helping shape funnel and active-experience coverage as the space matures.
Connect discovery to engagement
Route food-intent traffic into the Cooking Companion / Cookbook experience (web-to-app save, cook-along, shopping lists) to build daily active users, not just sessions.
Own one integrated, prioritized organic-discovery roadmap that keeps content, product, engineering, data, and AI measurement connected.
Raise the bar & lead through influence
Set the standard for product thinking, experimentation rigor, and quality-first sequencing across the squad.
Drive alignment across Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial on a single repeated message and a shared definition of organic success.

Deep SEO expertise (must-have): 6+ years in product management with hands-on ownership of technical and content SEO at scale indexation, structured data, internal linking, SSR, content infrastructure, and large content programs. You have personally moved non-branded organic traffic for a large, content-rich site and know how to scale content without tanking quality.
GEO / AI search fluency (must-have): Demonstrable understanding of how LLMs retrieve, cite, and repeat brand narratives, and how to influence them, AI-citable content formats, third-party signal building, and measurement of AI visibility (e.g., Profound or equivalent). You can articulate where GEO overlaps with SEO and where it diverges.
Content + platform product sense: Experience shipping content automation, CMS/platform migrations, or publishing infrastructure, working with Data/ML for tagging, deduplication, and quality guardrails.
Insight-driven, quantitative rigor: Comfortable in search analytics, GSC, Ahrefs/STAT-type tooling and funnel data; you work backwards from user intent and defend decisions with evidence.
High agency & ownership: You diagnose, decide, and drive in ambiguous, fast-moving spaces and you're energized by standing up a discipline rather than maintaining one.
Global cross-functional leadership: You influence and align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial without direct authority and communicate at publication quality.
Staff-level behavior: You set direction across teams, resolve ambiguity without escalation, and operate as a single-threaded leader for a strategic surface.
What sets you apart
Agentic Commerce / LLM distribution experience (nice-to-have): Hands-on experience building on MCP, the Apps SDK, Stripe's ACP, or Google's UCP or shipping commerce/discovery experiences inside ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. This is the direction we are steering the team, and prior exposure is a strong differentiator.
Experience in subscription, DTC, or consumer businesses where LTV, churn, and contribution margin are the governing metrics.
Fluency in SQL and/or Python sufficient to interrogate data pipelines and collaborate as a peer with data science.
Background in food, recipe, or publisher-scale content ecosystems.

A mandate to build a durable, category-defining organic growth engine at one of the world's most data-rich consumer companies with direct visibility to senior leadership.
A rare chance to lead a discipline through an inflection point, evolving SEO into GEO and helping define HelloFresh's Agentic Commerce future.
Box Discount-Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
Health & Wellness-Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

Own and drive the product roadmap for materials data and procurement-related workflows, from vision through execution.

5+ years of product management experience on modern software products.
A track record of shipping workflow-heavy products with measurable business impact.
Experience with B2B SaaS, supply chain, procurement, ERP, commerce infrastructure, data platforms, or other operational software.
The ability to translate complex business processes into intuitive product experiences and scalable systems.
Comfort working with structured data models, systems integrations, and multi-party workflows.
Strong communication skills across engineering, design, operations, and business audiences.

At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.
In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.
The Mission
Empower developers and business users with the tools to maximize their use of Algolia’s Search platform. Our team builds advanced analytics, debugging tools, and applications that enhance keyword search capabilities, helping customers make data-driven decisions.
The Opportunity
The Search team at Algolia runs the world’s fastest and most relevant search engine . We operate one platform that covers ALL retrieval methods - keyword, semantic, db, and others. We eat, breathe, and sleep highly available and highly reliable services (4 9s is our minimum threshold).

We build products that enable anyone to easily connect any data source and retrieve and collate content across multiple data sources. We inform our customers how best to optimize their discovery engines through automation and products. We run both the public cloud and our own bare metal because we demand the best performance.

And, we are just getting started.

Our AI Search team is a remote-first, multicultural group committed to innovation and inclusion. We focus on three key areas of search: Understanding, Ranking, and Retrieval. We are looking for a Product Leader to drive the long-term vision and execution of AI Search.

As Director of Product for AI Search, you will operate at the intersection of customer value, technical systems, product strategy, and execution. Translating deep search capabilities into products customers understand, adopt, and trust. You will:
Define and communicate the strategy, vision, and roadmap for AI Search, working closely with the Executive Leadership Team.
Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, search trends, and emerging technologies to guide product direction.
Align closely with go-to-market teams to drive feature adoption and continuously refine our offerings based on customer feedback.
Partner with engineering and machine learning teams to develop technical product specifications and integrations.
Foster a culture of agility and innovation, promoting rapid prototyping and iterative learning.
Assess product development progress, identify enhancement opportunities, and ensure continuous improvement.
Manage budgets, forecasts, and key performance metrics.
Identify market trends, competitive positioning, and potential strategic partnerships.
Build and lead a world-class team of product managers.

Proven experience in technical B2B product management, ideally in search, AI search, retrieval systems, recommendation systems, data platforms, or API-driven infrastructure products .
Strong hands-on understanding of modern search systems, including retrieval, ranking, relevance tuning, query understanding, indexing, filtering, faceting, and evaluation .
Familiarity with AI/ML-powered search approaches such as semantic search, vector search, hybrid retrieval, learning-to-rank, personalisation, reranking, embeddings, or LLM-powered search experiences .
Leadership experience managing and scaling product management teams.
A track record of successfully shipping and iterating on products in an agile development environment.
The ability to translate complex technical challenges into strategic business solutions.
Experience engaging with high-profile customers, including presenting roadmaps and gathering feedback.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced startup environment.
Hands-on expertise with search engines, real-time APIs, and AI/ML-powered products.

An Introduction to Primer
Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.
Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.
Watch our showcase >
Read up on our $100m Series C

Which team will you be joining?
Getting paid is only half the story. Understanding and managing those payments is where the real work begins.
In the Financial Operations team we build the tools and infrastructure that let merchants take control of their payments: reconciling funds, monitoring performance, and automating the operations that keep everything running. We also own Global Accounts, giving merchants the ability to hold, manage and move funds across currencies and markets, a foundational capability as Primer expands into more complex, cross-border payment environments.
The team spans Reconciliation, Operations Automation, Global Accounts and FX. As a Product Manager here you will own a sub-area within that: a coherent slice of the product where you own the problems, the prioritisation and the outcomes over multiple quarters.
You will work day to day with a dedicated engineering team and design partner, alongside GTM, and report into the Product lead for the area. Primer is remote-first and globally distributed, and always will be. We run on written thinking, low bureaucracy and real ownership. You build it, you own it, end to end.
What will you be doing?
Owning the outcomes for your sub-area of Financial Operations over multiple quarters, not just shipping a backlog
Defining the problems worth solving in your scope by synthesising merchant feedback, support data, competitive moves and platform constraints
Planning and delivering initiatives independently, making real-time trade-offs on scope, sequencing and quality to protect both timelines and outcomes
Writing specs that anticipate the edge cases that actually matter in payments operations: reconciliation breaks, currency and settlement complexity
Partnering closely with engineering on feasibility and technical trade-offs, and defining the leading and lagging metrics that tell you whether your sub-area is working
Owning launch readiness and driving rapid post-launch iteration based on what the data shows
Representing your sub-area to merchants and internal stakeholders, turning operational complexity into clear product decisions

A track record of owning a product sub-area or significant feature set end to end, with outcomes that can be traced back to your decisions
The ability to define problems independently from messy inputs, rather than waiting for a fully formed brief
Sound, autonomous trade-offs on scope, quality and technical debt within your scope
Enough technical fluency to partner with engineers on feasibility and integration implications, not just hand over requirements
Clear, structured communication that keeps engineering, design and GTM aligned and surfaces risks early

Experience in payments, fintech, or operational and back-office product such as reconciliation, ledgers, treasury or FX
Comfort with data analysis to define and track outcome metrics
You may not like it here
Financial operations is detail-heavy and unforgiving. Reconciliation and FX have real money and real edge cases attached. If you prefer broad, abstract product work to getting the details exactly right, this will frustrate you.
You are expected to define what is worth solving in your sub-area, with support rather than direction.
We are remote-first and async by default. If you need people physically around you to do your best work, this is a real adjustment, not a perk.
Feedback here is direct and frequent. You are expected to give it as well as take it.

We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.
We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes.

You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers.

This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.

OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.
This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.
AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

Recorded Future is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own and advance takedown capabilities within our Digital Risk Protection portfolio. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad ownership and visibility across a critical area of the business.
The work sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, product development, automation, external partnerships, and business strategy, with the opportunity to shape how Recorded Future delivers and scales takedown outcomes globally.

Own the strategy and roadmap: Define the vision, priorities, and operating model for takedown capabilities within Digital Risk Protection.
Strengthen service delivery: Assess current workflows, performance, escalations, and customer pain points, then drive immediate and sustained improvements.
Scale the capability: Prioritize the highest-impact takedown types and translate complex operational requirements into scalable product workflows.
Design the operating model: Partner with Engineering and AI teams to improve validation, evidence collection, authorization, submission, monitoring, escalation, verification, and reporting, including where automation or human review is required.
Establish safeguards: Work with Legal and external experts to address authorization, false positives, liability, policy requirements, and regional differences.
Build the external ecosystem: Develop relationships with registrars, hosting providers, platforms, and other disruption partners to improve speed and success.
Measure and grow impact: Establish meaningful performance metrics and partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on packaging, monetization, adoption, retention, and growth.

Deep, direct experience executing, designing, or leading digital takedown services, with meaningful ownership of the takedown lifecycle.
Strong understanding of how requirements and execution vary by threat type, provider, platform, geography, evidence standard, and legal or policy basis.
Experience across relevant use cases such as phishing, malicious sites, domain abuse, impersonation, trademark or copyright infringement, social media abuse, or exposed code and data.
Experience turning complex, manual operations into product strategy, requirements, workflows, and scalable technology.
Technical fluency with APIs, automation, AI-assisted workflows, integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Strong judgment around customer impact, false positives, liability, and when to involve legal or other subject-matter experts.
Demonstrated ability to align Product, Engineering, Legal, Support, and commercial teams without relying on a large dedicated organization.
A hands-on, curious, and collaborative approach, with the ability to solve immediate problems while building the longer-term model.
Existing relationships with registrars, hosting providers, platforms, or disruption partners are valuable. The ability and willingness to build them is essential.

Anyone can build AI insurance software now. The models are commoditized. The demos work. Almost nobody starts where Agency Revolution starts: thousands of independent P&C agencies already paying us to communicate with their clients, plus deep integrations into the systems where agency data actually lives.
The opportunity is the relationship layer — the system that notices when an agency's clients are at risk of churning, spots the cross-sell opportunity, picks the right message and channel and moment, and acts. We call it RelationshipOS. For ten years, agencies have trusted us to speak to their clients.

Now we're expanding what we can see: call transcripts, carrier communications, life events. The policies live in the agency's management system. The relationship lives with us. Nobody else has both the permission and the infrastructure.
We know what we're betting on. We don't yet know what makes an agency owner act on it. That's the job.
The strategic thesis is set. What's unresolved is whether it's true — whether an agency will actually change what they do because our system told them to, and what has to be built for that to happen. You're hired to answer that by shipping, not by studying.

s.h: Two halves, and you need both
s.t:
You personally build the bet. The intelligence layer is your work. Discovery with agency owners, prototypes in front of them within days, the smallest version that proves someone will act. Much of this is assembled rather than authored — the right vendor wired into AR Connect and pointed at a real use case will beat anything we could build from scratch this year. You don't hand this half to your team; it's too early and too ambiguous to delegate.
Your team drives the day-to-day execution and health of the existing platform. Two Product Owners and a Product Analyst keep a profitable, decade-old product healthy and improving. You set their priorities, strengthen their product judgment, raise their craft, and shield them from thrash. You remain the primary product manager responsible for the roadmap, discovery, and strategic product decisions. Done well, this is what buys you the time to do the first half.
Most people are good at one of these. We need someone who won't quietly abandon the other.
This position offers $125,000-$140,000 depending on experience and qualifications.

RelationshipOS — the intelligence layer. Churn signals. Cross-sell opportunities. Adaptive customer journeys instead of rigid sequences. You define what "acted on" means, instrument it, and are accountable for the number.
AR Connect and the vendor stack. AR Connect is our integration layer — where APIs pull in calls, carrier communications, life events, and other signals, and where third-party capability plugs into our distribution. It's the substrate the whole thesis sits on, and it's how a promising vendor becomes a live use case in front of agencies.
That work is yours: mapping the landscape of management systems, carrier connections, data enrichment providers, and AI vendors; deciding what we integrate versus build; running the POCs; and getting from "interesting demo" to something an agency actually uses. Data quality, latency, unit economics, and what happens when a vendor's model is wrong are your problems to surface early. You shape the deals and bring the recommendation — the SVP and our partnership team close them.
Voice AI as a channel. Not a feature — a real channel. Define the MVP, run pilots where AI handles outbound outreach with warm handoffs to agencies, and produce the evidence for whether this moves us from subscription toward outcome-based pricing.
The Agency Revolution roadmap. What ships, in what order, and what we stop doing. You own the sequencing and defend it.
